questions.instructions: Does the current admitted measurement have exactly the same metric key, unit, grain, and scope as the objective? Use unknown only when either side lacks those coordinates.

options.description: all declared measurement coordinates match exactly
at least one declared measurement coordinate differs
the comparison cannot be made because coordinates are absent

questions.instructions: Classify absolute materiality. A result is material only when objective and current coordinates match, both current and previous are complete measured evidence, and the absolute value change is at least the objective minimum change. It is low when those conditions hold but the change is smaller. Otherwise it is unknown.

options.description: supported measured change meets or exceeds the declared minimum
supported measured change is below the declared minimum
materiality cannot be supported from the stated evidence

questions.instructions: Is there a compatible forecast issued before the observation with a standard deviation that supports a standardized forecast residual?

options.description: a compatible prior forecast and deviation are present
no compatible prior forecast and deviation are present

questions.instructions: Does the state explicitly declare admitted counterevidence?

options.description: one or more counterevidence references are explicitly present
no counterevidence reference is present

questions.instructions: Is the evidence sufficient to classify materiality? It must match the objective and contain comparable current and previous complete measured observations with known unit and grain.

options.description: all stated requirements are satisfied
one or more stated requirements are not satisfied

questions.instructions: Choose priority in this order: mandatory when any mandatory reason is present; investigate for material change or explicit counterevidence; evidence_gap when evidence is insufficient or materiality unknown; routine otherwise.

options.description: a mandatory policy reason is explicitly present
supported material change or explicit counterevidence requires investigation
missing or insufficient evidence must be resolved
supported low change with no conflict or mandatory reason
the state does not support any listed scheduling class

questions.instructions: Choose retained-search for supported material change or explicit counterevidence; choose native-assessment for insufficient evidence or mandatory review; choose abstain for a supported low change with no mandatory reason or counterevidence.

options.description: retrieve admitted retained conclusions to discriminate explanations
continue deterministic assessment or request missing admitted evidence
no additional analytical work is indicated
